in_sanskrit.name: Dimpi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Durga's loving form
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dimpi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Dimpi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dimpana', which refers to the loving form of the goddess Durga. In Hindu mythology, Durga is considered the mother of the universe and the protector of all beings. The name Dimpi signifies the deep devotion and love one has for the divine mother.
